answer: Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, slashed on a failed audit, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. The atlas is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the trellis. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. What survives to the willow is a record of labour, not a list of addresses.
